entities.name: Methyl aryl glyoxylate
observations: Contains a methyl ester adjacent to a ketone and is therefore a substrate for base-promoted ester hydrolysis.

entities.name: NaOH aqueous methanol
observations: Decoded reagents include sodium hydroxide, water, and methanol; tetrahydrofuran is also present as an organic solvent.
These conditions are consistent with saponification of a methyl ester.

entities.name: Sodium aryl glyoxylate
observations: The methyl ester group is converted to a sodium carboxylate while the adjacent ketone remains unchanged.

entities.name: Aryl glyoxylic acid
observations: After acidic workup, the corresponding neutral product would be O=C(O)C(=O)c1ccc(SCCOc2ccc3ccccc3c2)cc1.
This is the free α-keto acid form of the sodium carboxylate.
